title: Degrees of Initiation
subtitle: The path within the Order
text: The Hermit gives a heart; the Vicar receives a willing Harbinger. The attached charm marks Degree 0. Formal initiation settles it and grants Degree 1. A bloodline founder of Degree 5 or higher can also initiate you through Blood Projection, receiving you into their bloodline. The Alchemist then entrusts Concentrated Blood to those who finish their first separation. Inject it and rest: the body needs time to make room for its inheritance. You wake at Degree 2. From there, the Living Staff and Cardinal Rites carry the later degrees. Most Harbingers — most outposts, most individual groups — only ever reach Illuminatus, the fifth degree. To the average practitioner, this is the summit. The existence of Degrees 6 and 7 is known only to those who reach them. The existence of an eighth has no formal name among those who know of it. They call it, simply, the Silence. The Hematic Order itself, the Vicar says, is not a rank. It is a state of being — one where the blood becomes indistinguishable from the blood of the world.
